en.answer: When <<6181>> is destroyed as an Equip Spell Card, it is not treated as a Machine-Type monster being destroyed, so Junk Counters are not placed on <<8668>>.
en.question: If <<6181>> is destroyed while it is treated as an Equip Spell Card, are 2 Junk Counters placed on <<8668>>?
